title: using get_orphan_node_ids not lists all orphans
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

I'm actually improving my orphan detection system for GdUnit4 and using `get_orphan_node_ids` to find in the first step all orphan objects.
It only lists orphans of type Node and misses the Object orphans, but when running the same script on the command line with the --verbose option, the sysout shows all orphans.

So this function is incomplete or mismatched with the running as external with the --verbose option result.

I know the name 'get_orphan_node_ids' suggests only nodes, but pure Object can also be orphans.

Is there a function to list all orphans inclusive objects?


### Steps to reproduce

Run this script as showcase in Editor:
```gd
extends GdUnitTestSuite

@warning_ignore_start("unused_private_class_variable")
var _member_ref1 := RefCounted.new() # is refcounted and never orphan
var _member_obj1 := Object.new() # produces an orphan Object
var _member_node1 := Node2D.new() # produces an orphan Node2D


func test_show_orphans() -> void:
	var _func_ref2 := RefCounted.new() # is refcounted and never orphan
	var _func_obj2 := Object.new() # produces an orphan Object
	var _func_node2 := Node3D.new() # produces an orphan Node3D

	prints("%d orphans detected" % Node.get_orphan_node_ids().size())
	for orphan_id in Node.get_orphan_node_ids():
		prints(instance_from_id(orphan_id))
```

it shows on Godot console only the orphan nodes
```bash
2 orphans detected
<Node2D#112591898293>
<Node3D#115444025052>
```

But running on command line with --verbose argument the report shows all orphans inclusive the objects.
